recalls.Description: This recall involves outdoor Sharper Image-Branded Tabletop Fire Pits and Sharper Image-Branded Tabletop Infinity Fire Pits. The units have a “77” logo on the front, a Lot Code sticker in the center of the base, a round black sticker marked “CHINA” with a 5-digit code, the letters KS-CY or KS-FC, and a date code in YYYY-MM-DD format. The Sharper Image-Branded Tabletop Fire Pits feature a small cylindrical concrete body with a removable snuffing lid and an open burn chamber at the top. The Sharper Image-Branded Tabletop Infinity Fire Pits feature a steel base and tempered‑glass side panels.
recalls.Title: Allstar Recalls Sharper Image Tabletop and Infinity Fire Pits Due to Risk of Serious Injury from Burn and Fire Hazards
recalls.ConsumerContact: Allstar toll-free at 855-215-5032 from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. ET Monday through Friday, email at allstarmarketing6861@sedgwick.com  or online at www.firepitrecall.expertinquiry.com or www.allstarmg.com and click on “Fire Pit Safety Recall” at the bottom of the page for more information.

Products.Name: Sharper Image Tabletop Fire Pits and Sharper Image Tabletop Infinity Fire Pits

Images.Caption: Sharper Image Tabletop Infinity Fire Pits

Injuries.Name: The firm has received four reports of ignited fuel escaping from the unit during use, resulting in four injuries including third and fourth degree burns to multiple body parts.

Retailers.Name:
Sold At:
Ace Hardware, Burlington, Home Depot, Lowe’s, Kohl’s, Marshalls, Nordstrom, Rite Aid, Target, TJ Maxx, Walgreens, Walmart and other retailers nationwide, and online, including Amazon.com and Hsn.com from January 2023 through June 2026 for between $30 and $50.

Importers.Name: Allstar Marketing Group, LLC, of Winston-Salem, North Carolina

Hazards.Name: Ignited flammable liquid can escape from the recalled fire pits or trigger flame jetting from the fuel containers, posing a risk of serious injury from burn and fire hazards.

Remedies.Name: Consumers should stop using the recalled fire pits immediately and contact Allstar for a full refund. Consumers will be asked to register at www.firepitrecall.expertinquiry.com, write “RECALLED – DO NOT USE” in permanent marker, and submit three photographs following the instructions on Allstar’s recall page. After registration is confirmed, consumers should dispose of any remaining fuel in accordance with local hazardous-waste requirements and discard the recalled fire pits safely.

recalls.Description: This recall involves Boshengya-branded rugs. The pink or orange shag area rugs measure about 5 or 6 feet wide and 8 feet long. ‘INCREDIBLY SOFT’ is printed on a label on the product packaging.
recalls.Title: Boshengya Recalls Rugs Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Fire Hazard; Violate Mandatory Standard for Carpets and Rugs

Images.Caption: Recalled Boshengya Shag Area Rug - Pink
Recalled Boshengya Shag Area Rug - Orange
‘INCREDIBLY SOFT’ is printed on a label on the product packaging of the recalled Boshengya shag area rugs.

Retailers.Name:
Sold Online At:
Amazon.com from September 2026 through October 2026 for between $30 and $65.
Boshengya Dianzi Shangwu (Tianjin) Youxian Gongsi (Boshengya E-Commerce Tianjin Co., Ltd.), dba Boshengya, of China

Hazards.Name: The recalled rugs violate the mandatory standard for the flammability of carpets and rugs, posing a risk of serious injury or death from fire hazard.

Remedies.Name: Consumers should stop using the rugs immediately and contact Boshengya for a full refund. Consumers will be asked to destroy the rug by cutting it in half and send a photo of the destroyed rug to boshengya666@outlook.com. Consumers will then dispose of the recalled product.

recalls.Description: This recall involves the Cummins Onan P5000iDF EFI Dual Fuel Portable Generators sold in a dark gray color. The generators can operate on gasoline or propane, and produce between 4,500 and 5,000 watts, depending on fuel. “Cummins” is printed in white on the front of the unit and the handle above the control panel. The Cummins "C" logo and "Onan P5000iDF EFI" are printed on the side. The model and part number can be found on the label attached to the side of the generator.
recalls.Title: Cummins Recalls Portable Generators Due to Risk of Serious Injury from Fire and Burn Hazards
recalls.ConsumerContact: Cummins at 800-286-6467 Monday through Friday anytime or online at www.cummins.com/en-na/na/generators/portable-generators/safety-recalls/campaigns/7308 or go to www.cummins.com/en-na/na/generators/portable-generators and click on “Safety Recalls” at the top of the page for more information.

Products.Name: Cummins Onan P5000iDF EFI Dual Fuel Portable Generators

Images.Caption: Recalled Cummins Onan P5000iDF EFI Dual Fuel Portable Generator
Label on the side of the generator with the model and part number

Injuries.Name: The firm has received eleven reports of fuel discharging from the unit and the fuel cap ejecting unexpectedly, including one consumer reporting being splashed in the face with fuel. No medical attention was needed.

Retailers.Name:
Sold At:
Camping World, Factory Pure, Northern Tool, AP Electric stores and online atCummins.com from May 2025 through August 2026 for between $1,640 and $1,930.

Hazards.Name: The valves in the recalled generators were installed incorrectly, preventing fuel vapors from venting properly from the gasoline tank, causing excessive pressure to build up. This pressure can cause fuel to discharge or the fuel cap to eject, posing a risk of serious injury from fire and burn hazards.

Remedies.Name: Consumers should stop using the recalled portable generators immediately and go to https://www.cummins.com/en-na/na/generators/portable-generators/safety-recalls/campaigns/7308 to check if the model and part number is included in the recall.  If your unit is affected, contact an authorized Cummins service location and arrange for a free repair at the service location. To find a service location near you, please use the Service Locator link at https://quickserve.cummins.com.

recalls.Description: This recall involves Buzz Bicycles Cerana T2 E-Trike, model E4004. The tricycle is a pedal assist tricycle. The tricycle is gray with "BUZZ" logos on the left and right side. The tricycle has a 500-Watt motor and a 48-Volt battery. The tricycle has three 24-inch wheels. The model number is printed on a label near the pedals on the bottom side of the frame’s downtube.
recalls.Title: Huffy Recalls Buzz Bicycles Cerana T2 E-Trikes Due to Risk of Serious Injury from Fall Hazard
recalls.ConsumerContact: Huffy Corporation toll-free at 855-430-6240 from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. ET Monday through Friday, email at service@huffy.com or online at https://www.buzzbicycles.com/recalls or at www.buzzbicycles.com and click on “Recalls” at the top of the page for more information.

Images.Caption: Recalled Buzz Bicycles Cerana T2 E-Trike, model E4004

Injuries.Name: The firm has received 12 reports of the rear wheel becoming loose or separating, resulting in three injuries of shoulder and wrists sprains, leg bruising and abrasions.

Retailers.Name:
Sold At:
Independent bike shops nationwide and online atwww.buzzbicycles.com from November 2024 through July 2026 for between $1,400 and $2,500.

Hazards.Name: The recalled tricycles’ rear wheels can become loose or separate from the rear frame, posing a risk of serious injury from a fall hazard.

Remedies.Name: Consumers should stop using the recalled tricycles immediately and contact Huffy for free replacement rear axle assemblies. The rear wheel axle assemblies will be sent directly to consumers or to a third-party who will repair the tricycle. Huffy Corporation will reimburse consumers up to $100 for charges incurred by the third-party repair.

recalls.Description: This recall involves the Kakgold 4WD stunt vehicles with a remote-control containing button cell and lithium-ion batteries. The toy car has a lime green and blue body, a black chassis and four black wheels with lime green trim and diagonal rollers. The vehicle body features checkered patterns, an “X” design and the words “PRO” and “RACING.” A white hang tag attached to the vehicle body displays “Do Not Twist the Shaft” in red lettering and illustrations marked with red crosses.
recalls.Title: Kakgold Recalls 4WD Remote-Controlled Car Toys Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Battery Ingestion; Violate Mandatory Standard for Toys

Images.Caption: Recalled Kakgold 4WD Stunt Vehicle Toy – packaging front
Remote-control containing button cell and lithium-ion batteries
Recalled Kakgold 4WD Stunt Vehicle Toy – top view with hang tag

Retailers.Name:
Sold Online At:
Amazon.com from July 2026 throughSeptember 2026 for between $34 and $50.
Shenzhenshi Juteng Lechuang Technology Co., Ltd., dba Kakgold, of China

Hazards.Name: The recalled remote-controlled cars violate the mandatory standard for toys because they contain button cell and lithium-ion batteries in the remote control that can be easily accessed by children, posing a deadly ingestion hazard to children. When button cell or coin batteries are swallowed, the ingested batteries can cause serious injuries, internal chemical burns and death

Remedies.Name:
Consumers should stop using the remote-controlled car toys immediately and contact Kakgold for information on how to receive a full refund. Consumers will be asked to write “RECALLED” on the product and email a photograph showing the product being properly disposed of in the trash to kakrecall@outlook.com.

Note: Button cell batteries are hazardous. Batteries should be disposed of or recycled by following local hazardous waste procedures.

recalls.Description: This recall involves QIOMALA-branded pressure washers with model number “HWT12P”. The 1.2 GPM electric pressure washers were sold in green with black and in blue with black and measure about 14 inches deep, 11 inches wide and 15 inches high. The pressure washers came with a 500 ml soap tank, four quick disconnect nozzles and a 20-foot hose. Model number “HWT12P” is printed on a label on back of the unit, near the power cord entry point.
recalls.Title: QIOMALA Pressure Washers Recalled Due to Serious Risk of Injury or Death from Shock and Electrocution Hazards

Images.Caption: Recalled QIOMALA electric pressure washer-model HWT12P (green)
Recalled QIOMALA electric pressure washer-model HWT12P (blue)
Model number “HWT12P” shown on a label located on back of the recalled product

Retailers.Name:
Sold Online At:
Amazon.comfrom April 2026through June 2026 for about $130.

Importers.Name: Ningbo Miyao E-Commerce Co., dba QIOMALA, of China

Hazards.Name: The recalled pressure washers lack an adequate-length power cord, which can encourage use of an extension cord, posing a serious risk of injury or death from shock and electrocution hazards.

Remedies.Name: Consumers should stop using the recalled pressure washers immediately and contact QIOMALA for a full refund. Consumers will be asked to unplug the pressure washer, cut the power cord in half and send a photo of the destroyed power washer, showing the model number, to QIOMALA@163.com. Consumers should then dispose of the destroyed recalled product.

recalls.Description: This recall involves Baby Rattle and Teether Toy Sets. The sets include seven toys in a variety of pastel colors and shapes. SKU “sk25070936134444119” is located on the upper right corner of a label on the product packaging.
recalls.Title: SHEIN Distribution Corporation Recalls Baby Rattle and Teether Toy Sets Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Choking; Violate Mandatory Small Parts Ban
recalls.ConsumerContact: SHEIN toll-free at 833-853-8668 from 9 a.m. to 6 p.m. PT Monday through Friday, by email at uscsteam@shein.com or online at https://us.shein.com/product-recalls/list or https://us.shein.com and click on “Product Recalls” at the bottom of the page for more information.

Hazards.Name: The recalled toy sets violate the small parts ban because they are intended for children under three years old and the purple and orange knobs can detach from the product, posing a deadly choking hazard to young children.

Remedies.Name: Consumers should stop using the recalled toy sets immediately, take them away from children, and contact SHEIN for a refund. Consumers will be asked to affirm they disposed of the toy sets to receive a refund.
